name: Purple sticky rice
summary: Thái sticky rice dyed purple with lá khẩu cắm. Báo Sơn La, on 16 July 2026, says the leaf is green when fresh and gives a deep purple liquor after it is boiled. Soak the sticky rice in that liquor, then steam it. The cook in xã Thuận Châu starts before dawn. It is a feast, Tết, and guest dish. A caption pairs it with chéo cá nục.
